description: List recent public mentions of the competitors you track and of your own product (Hacker News and Reddit), newest first, paginated. Each mention carries sentiment and intent (praise, complaint, question, comparison, alternative_seeking, news). Filter by competitor domain, channel, sentiment or intent.

channel.description: Only this channel: hacker_news, reddit, or web

competitor.description: Only mentions of this tracked competitor's domain, e.g. 'rival.com' (your own product's domain works too)

intent.description: Only this intent: praise, complaint, question, comparison, alternative_seeking, news, or other

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0); use next_offset from the previous page

sentiment.description: Only this sentiment: positive, negative, or neutral

name: outmano_list_competitor_mentions

comments.description: Hacker News comment count; absent elsewhere

intent.description: praise, complaint, question, comparison, alternative_seeking, news or other

mentions_competitors.description: Other tracked names in the same mention

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to fetch the next page; absent on the last page
